semantics: palette: the twelve names in palette order; light and dark {tint, tint_soft, on_tint} as lowercase #rrggbb. Every on_tint on its tint has a WCAG 2 contrast of at least min_contrast. Text on tint_soft is ink, never tint.

icons: NFC, then a first scalar that is Extended_Pictographic but not Emoji_Presentation, not followed by U+FE0F, gets U+FE0F after it; then at most max_icon_length code points (the stored form); then exactly one extended grapheme cluster; then it starts as an emoji: s0 Extended_Pictographic and (s0 Emoji_Presentation or s1 == U+FE0F), or s0 and s1 regional indicators, or s0 in [0-9#*] with s1 == U+FE0F and s2 == U+20E3. The value is not trimmed. expected.value is the stored form; a refusal's message is the server's (clients word their own).

tags: each tag in order: Python str.strip() and inner whitespace runs collapsed to one space (str.isspace: Unicode White_Space plus U+001C-U+001F); refused when empty, when it holds a control character (Cc), when longer than max_tag_length code points, or when its str.casefold() equals an earlier tag's (the later one is refused, nothing is dropped); then at most max_tags. loc is tags.{i} for a tag, tags for the count; the first failing tag wins, before the count.

reminder_titles: the title is '{icon} {topic_name}' with an icon, else topic_name; expected is that title cut to max_title_length Unicode scalars with '…' (the due Notification's title, so Web Push and APNs, and the iOS local reminder); the cut is from the end, so the emoji stays.
